title: A new partial-equilibrium approach to approximating the welfare effects of market power and taxes
title_zh: 市场势力与税收福利效应近似的一种新局部均衡方法
title_primary: 市场势力与税收福利效应近似的一种新局部均衡方法
title_secondary: A new partial-equilibrium approach to approximating the welfare effects of market power and taxes
authors: Till Gross, Paul Klein
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The traditional deadweight-loss (DWL) formula rests on a usually unstated, strong assumption: that all other markets are undistorted. We extend the partial-equilibrium DWL formula to cases where the surplus in other markets is non-zero. It involves an additional term of the same order of magnitude as the DWL; this term does not go to zero even when the directly affected market is small relative to the rest of the economy. In examples, we show that the DWL may get the sign of the surplus change wrong when a substantial share of the economy is monopolized or subject to commodity taxes.
abstract_zh: 传统的无谓损失（DWL）公式基于一个通常未明说的强假设：所有其他市场均无扭曲。我们将局部均衡的DWL公式扩展到其他市场剩余非零的情形。该扩展涉及一个与DWL同数量级的额外项；即使直接受影响的市场相对于经济整体规模很小，这一项也不会趋于零。通过实例，我们表明当经济中相当大比例被垄断或受商品税影响时，DWL可能错误地判断剩余变化的符号。

title: Managing Perishable Inventory Systems with Positive Lead Times: Inventory Position vs. Projected Inventory Level
title_zh: 正提前期下易逝品库存系统管理：库存位置与预测库存水平
title_primary: 正提前期下易逝品库存系统管理：库存位置与预测库存水平
title_secondary: Managing Perishable Inventory Systems with Positive Lead Times: Inventory Position vs. Projected Inventory Level
authors: Jinzhi Bu, Xiting Gong, Huanyu Yin
official: 官方在线 2026-08-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study periodic review perishable inventory systems with a fixed product lifetime, positive replenishment lead times, and a general issuance policy under the average cost criterion. The optimal replenishment policy for such systems is notoriously complex and computationally intractable because of the curse of dimensionality. To address this challenge, we propose a class of projected inventory level (PIL) policies, which maintain a constant expected on-hand inventory level, and compare them with conventional base-stock (BS) policies that maintain a constant inventory position. For both backlogging and lost-sales systems, we show that the best PIL policy is asymptotically optimal with large unit penalty costs for a broad class of unbounded demand distributions. When demand is bounded and the unit penalty cost is sufficiently large, we prove that the best BS policy is optimal under first-in-first-out issuance, whereas the best PIL policy is optimal under last-in-first-out issuance (under certain conditions). Furthermore, we show that both policies are asymptotically optimal as the demand population size grows large, and their optimality gaps diminish exponentially fast in backlogging systems under a broad range of issuance policies. To facilitate computation, we introduce a class of approximate PIL (APIL) policies and extend most theoretical results for PIL to the APIL policy. Numerical results show that both PIL and APIL policies perform very close to optimal and significantly outperform BS policies. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. Yin were partially supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72425008] and the Hong Kong Research Grants Council General Research Fund [Grant CUHK14500120]. J. Bu was partially supported by the Hong Kong Research Grants Council General Research Fund [Grant PolyU15504525]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03801 .
abstract_zh: 我们研究具有固定产品寿命、正补货提前期以及一般发放策略的周期性审查易腐品库存系统，在平均成本准则下进行探讨。此类系统的最优补货策略因维度灾难而著称，极为复杂且计算上难以处理。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一类投影库存水平（PIL）策略，该策略维持恒定的预期现有库存水平，并将其与维持恒定库存位置的传统基准库存（BS）策略进行比较。对于缺货回补和销售损失两种系统，我们证明在广泛的无界需求分布类别中，最优PIL策略在大单位惩罚成本下具有渐近最优性。当需求有界且单位惩罚成本足够大时，我们证明在先进先出发放规则下最优BS策略为最优，而在后进先出发放规则下（在特定条件下）最优PIL策略为最优。此外，我们表明随着需求总体规模增大，两种策略均具有渐近最优性，且在缺货回补系统中，在广泛的发放策略下，其最优性差距以指数速度缩小。为便于计算，我们引入了一类近似PIL（APIL）策略，并将PIL的大部分理论结果扩展至APIL策略。数值结果表明，PIL和APIL策略的表现均非常接近最优，且显著优于BS策略。本文由Jeannette Song负责运营管理方向接受。资助：X. Gong和H. Yin部分受国家自然科学基金[批准号72425008]及香港研究资助局优配研究金[批准号CUHK14500120]资助。J. Bu部分受香港研究资助局优配研究金[批准号PolyU15504525]资助。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03801获取。

title: The Transmission of Reliable and Unreliable Information
title_zh: 可靠与不可靠信息的传播
title_primary: 可靠与不可靠信息的传播
title_secondary: The Transmission of Reliable and Unreliable Information
authors: Thomas Graeber, Shakked Noy, Christopher Roth
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Information often spreads and influences beliefs regardless of its reliability. We show that this occurs in part because indicators of reliability tend to be lost in the process of word-of-mouth transmission. We conduct controlled experiments where participants listen to economic forecasts and pass them on through voice messages. Other participants listen either to original or transmitted audio recordings and report incentivized beliefs. Across various transmitter incentive schemes, a claim’s reliability is lost in transmission much more than the claim itself. Reliable and unreliable information, once filtered through transmission, impact listener beliefs similarly. Mechanism experiments show that reliability is lost not because it is perceived as less relevant or harder to transmit, but because it is less likely to come to mind during transmission. Evidence from our experiments, a large corpus of everyday conversations, and economic TV news shows that contextual cues can bring reliability to mind and induce its transmission, but situations in which people share information seldom contain such cues.
abstract_zh: 信息往往在传播过程中影响人们的信念，无论其可靠性如何。我们证明，这种现象部分源于口碑传播过程中可靠性指标容易丢失。我们开展控制实验，让参与者听取经济预测并通过语音信息传递。其他参与者听取原始或转述的录音，并报告受激励的信念。在不同传递者激励方案下，信息的可靠性在传播中的损失程度远高于信息本身。可靠与不可靠的信息经过传播过滤后，对听众信念的影响趋于一致。机制实验表明，可靠性丢失并非因其被认为相关性较低或更难传递，而是因为在传播过程中更不易被想起。来自我们的实验、大规模日常对话语料库以及经济类电视新闻的证据显示，情境线索能够唤起对可靠性的关注并促使其传播，但人们分享信息的情境中很少包含此类线索。

title: Heterogenous Information About the Term Structure of Interest Rates, Least-Squares Learning and Optimal Interest Rate Rules
title_zh: 利率期限结构的异质性信息、最小二乘学习与最优利率规则
title_primary: 利率期限结构的异质性信息、最小二乘学习与最优利率规则
title_secondary: Heterogenous Information About the Term Structure of Interest Rates, Least-Squares Learning and Optimal Interest Rate Rules
authors: Eric Schaling, Sylvester Eijffinger, Mewael F. Tesfaselassie
official: 官方在线 2004-03-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this Paper we incorporate the term structure of interest rates in a standard inflation forecast targeting framework. Learning about the transmission process of monetary policy is introduced by having heterogeneous agents - i.e. the central bank and private agents - who have different information sets about the future sequence of short-term interest rates. We analyse inflation forecast targeting in two environments. One in which the central bank has perfect knowledge, in the sense that it understands and observes the process by which private sector interest rate expectations are generated, and one in which the central bank has imperfect knowledge and has to learn the private sector forecasting rule for short-term interest rates. In the case of imperfect knowledge, the central bank has to learn about private sector interest rate expectations, as the latter affect the impact of monetary policy through the expectations theory of the term structure of interest rates. Here following Evans and Honkapohja (2001), the learning scheme we investigate is that of least-squares learning (recursive OLS) using the Kalman filter. We find that optimal monetary policy under learning is a policy that separates estimation and control. Therefore, this model suggests that the practical relevance of the breakdown of the separation principle and the need for experimentation in policy may be limited.
abstract_zh: 本文将利率期限结构纳入标准的通胀预测目标框架。通过引入异质性主体（即中央银行与私人部门），两者对未来短期利率序列拥有不同的信息集，从而引入货币政策传导过程的学习机制。我们在两种环境下分析通胀预测目标：其一，中央银行具备完全知识，即其理解并观测私人部门利率预期生成过程；其二，中央银行存在不完全知识，需学习私人部门短期利率预测规则。在不完全知识情形下，中央银行必须学习私人部门利率预期，因为后者通过利率期限结构的预期理论影响货币政策传导效果。此处遵循Evans和Honkapohja（2001）的研究，我们采用基于卡尔曼滤波的最小二乘学习（递归OLS）方案。研究发现，学习条件下的最优货币政策是分离估计与控制的政策。因此，本模型表明，分离原则失效及政策实验需求的实践相关性可能有限。

title: The impact of artificial intelligence exposure on delayed retirement behavior: Evidence from China
title_zh: 人工智能暴露对延迟退休行为的影响：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 人工智能暴露对延迟退休行为的影响：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: The impact of artificial intelligence exposure on delayed retirement behavior: Evidence from China
authors: Xiahai Wei, Jianing Zhou, Chenyu Zeng, Lingzheng Yu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The accelerating pace of population aging has spurred governments worldwide to proactively tap into the potential of the elderly labor market. Policies such as raising the statutory retirement age and advancing the “silver dividend” initiative aim to convert demographic shifts into economic dividends. Meanwhile, artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping the nature of labor market. Existing research has largely focused on the determinants of retirement decisions or the labor market effects of AI, with relatively little attention paid to the delayed retirement behavior of older workers in the era of AI. Against this backdrop, this paper explores the impact of AI exposure on older workers' decisions to delay retirement and the underlying mechanisms. Using micro-level individual data from China, this paper finds that the higher the level of AI exposure in an older worker's occupation, the lower the probability of delaying retirement. Mechanism tests reveal that exposure to AI reduces older workers' probability of delayed retirement by leading to job displacement, a decline in work-related returns, and a loss of confidence in the future. Furthermore, it is found that the negative impact of AI exposure on delayed retirement is more pronounced in groups that are highly educated, male, in poor health, have high family income, have purchased pension insurance, and have children to support them. This paper offers insights and policy recommendations on how to better tap into the potential of the older workforce in the age of AI.
abstract_zh: 人口老龄化进程的加速促使世界各国政府积极挖掘老年劳动力市场的潜力，诸如提高法定退休年龄和推进“银发红利”计划等政策旨在将人口结构变化转化为经济红利。与此同时，人工智能（AI）正迅速重塑劳动力市场的本质。现有研究大多聚焦于退休决策的决定因素或AI对劳动力市场的影响，而对AI时代老年工人延迟退休行为的关注相对较少。在此背景下，本文探讨了AI暴露对老年工人延迟退休决策的影响及其内在机制。利用中国微观个体数据，本文发现，老年工人所在职业的AI暴露水平越高，其延迟退休的概率越低。机制检验揭示，AI暴露通过导致职业替代、工作回报下降以及对未来信心丧失，降低了老年工人延迟退休的概率。进一步研究发现，AI暴露对延迟退休的负面影响在受教育程度高、男性、健康状况差、家庭收入高、已购买养老保险以及有子女赡养的群体中更为显著。本文为如何在AI时代更好地挖掘老年劳动力潜力提供了见解和政策建议。

title: Family-Leave Mandates and Female Labor at U.S. Firms: Evidence from a Trade Shock
title_zh: 美国家庭休假强制令与企业女性劳动力：来自贸易冲击的证据
title_primary: 美国家庭休假强制令与企业女性劳动力：来自贸易冲击的证据
title_secondary: Family-Leave Mandates and Female Labor at U.S. Firms: Evidence from a Trade Shock
authors: Fariha Kamal, Asha Sundaram, Cristina J. Tello-Trillo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine how the 1993 Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) impacts the gender composition at U.S. firms experiencing a negative demand shock. Combining changes in Chinese imports across industries between 2000 and 2003 and a sharp regression discontinuity to identify FMLA status, we find that an increase in import competition decreases the share of female employment, earnings, and promotions at FMLA relative to non-FMLA firms. This effect is driven by women in prime child-bearing ages and without college degrees and is pronounced at firms with all male managers. These results suggest that job-protected leave mandates may exacerbate gender inequalities in response to adverse shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了1993年《家庭与医疗休假法案》（FMLA）如何影响遭受负面需求冲击的美国企业的性别构成。通过结合2000年至2003年间各行业中国进口变化，并利用断点回归方法识别FMLA适用状态，我们发现：相较于非FMLA企业，进口竞争加剧导致FMLA企业中女性就业比例、收入及晋升机会下降。这一效应主要由处于生育黄金年龄且未获得大学学位的女性群体驱动，并在管理层全为男性的企业中尤为显著。研究结果表明，带薪休假保障政策可能加剧企业在应对负面冲击时的性别不平等现象。

title: Financial globalisation and the weakening of the regulatory cycle
title_zh: 金融全球化与监管周期的弱化
title_primary: 金融全球化与监管周期的弱化
title_secondary: Financial globalisation and the weakening of the regulatory cycle
authors: Thilo Nils Hendrik Albers, Alexander Nützenadel, Tobias Scheib
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The regulatory cycles view, according to which periods of deregulation encourage greater risk-taking and credit booms, which culminate in financial crises and are followed by renewed regulation, rests largely on case studies of individual countries or particular crises. This column uses a new dataset covering 14 countries over the past century to show that the pattern observed after the Great Depression has been much weaker since the Global Financial Crisis. The authors argue that the reason is not simply a change in political priorities or regulatory philosophy. Increasing financial integration has made effective banking regulation at the national level progressively more difficult, shifting regulatory authority from national governments towards international coordination.
abstract_zh: 监管周期理论认为，放松管制时期会鼓励更大的风险承担和信贷繁荣，最终导致金融危机，随后迎来新一轮监管强化。这一观点主要基于对单个国家或特定危机的案例研究。本文利用覆盖14个国家过去一个世纪的新数据集，表明大萧条后观察到的这一模式自全球金融危机以来已显著弱化。作者认为，其原因并非仅仅是政治优先事项或监管理念的转变。日益加深的金融一体化使得国家层面的有效银行监管愈发困难，监管权力正从各国政府向国际协调机制转移。

title: Machine Learning Can Predict Shooting Victimization Well Enough to Help Prevent It
title_zh: 机器学习能够足够准确地预测枪击受害风险以助预防
title_primary: 机器学习能够足够准确地预测枪击受害风险以助预防
title_secondary: Machine Learning Can Predict Shooting Victimization Well Enough to Help Prevent It
authors: Sara B. Heller, Benjamin Jakubowski, Zubin Jelveh, Max Kapustin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using Chicago police data, we train a machine learning model to predict the risk of being shot in the next 18 months. Out-of-sample accuracy is strikingly high. A central concern with using police data is “baking in” bias, or overestimating risk for groups likelier to interact with police conditional on behavior. Our predictions, however, accurately recover risk across demographic groups. Legal, ethical, and practical barriers should prevent using victimization predictions to target law enforcement. But using them to target social services could increase both the potential for interventions to reduce shootings and the available statistical power to detect those reductions.
abstract_zh: 利用芝加哥警方数据，我们训练了一个机器学习模型，用于预测未来18个月内被枪击的风险。样本外预测准确度惊人地高。使用警方数据的一个核心担忧是“固化”偏见，即在行为条件相同的情况下，高估更可能与警方互动的群体的风险。然而，我们的预测准确还原了不同人口群体的风险水平。法律、伦理及实践障碍应阻止将受害风险预测用于执法目标锁定。但将其用于社会服务目标锁定，既能提升干预措施减少枪击事件的潜力，也能增强检测此类减少效果的统计效能。

title: Remote Work and City Structure
title_zh: 远程工作与城市结构
title_primary: 远程工作与城市结构
title_secondary: Remote Work and City Structure
authors: Monte, Ferdinando, Porcher, Charly, Rossi-Hansberg, Esteban
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Relative to remote work, working downtown facilitates valuable interactions with other in-office workers, but entails commuting costs. The resulting coordination mechanism can lead to multiple stationary equilibria with varying levels of remote work. Temporary reductions in commuters, as in the COVID-19 pandemic, can then lead to persistently large fractions of remote workers. Cellphone- based mobility data for the U.S. shows that commuting trips in the largest cities, which are more likely to exhibit multiplicity, have stabilized at only 60% of pre-pandemic levels, while they are fully back in smaller cities. Cities with permanently low commuting experience average welfare losses of 2.3%.
abstract_zh: 相较于远程办公，市中心工作虽能促进与其他在岗员工的有价值互动，但需承担通勤成本。由此产生的协调机制可能导致远程办公比例不同的多重稳态均衡。如同新冠疫情期间出现的通勤者暂时性减少，可能引发远程工作者比例持续高企的现象。基于美国手机信令数据的流动性研究表明，更易呈现多重均衡特征的大型城市通勤出行量仅恢复至疫情前水平的60%，而小型城市已完全恢复。通勤量持续低迷的城市平均福利损失达2.3%。

title: Social Status, Inequality, and Redistribution
title_zh: 社会地位、不平等与再分配
title_primary: 社会地位、不平等与再分配
title_secondary: Social Status, Inequality, and Redistribution
authors: Mark Gradstein, Luigi Ventura
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We explore implications of social status concerns for redistribution, income inequality, and growth in a political economy framework. Salience of such concerns leads to a propagation mechanism, whereby initial income inequality and reduced willingness to redistribute income reinforce each other, potentially giving rise to multiple steady states. An extension illustrates the possibility of a high redistribution cum low inequality steady state resulting in a higher steady‐state income level. Some of the model features are shown to be consistent with empirical regularities as reflected in survey data on social status attitudes.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文在政治经济学框架下探讨社会地位关注对再分配、收入不平等及经济增长的影响。此类关注的显著性会引发一种传导机制，其中初始收入不平等与再分配意愿的降低相互强化，可能形成多重稳态。扩展分析表明，高再分配与低不平等并存的稳态可能导致更高的稳态收入水平。模型的部分特征与社会地位态度调查数据所反映的实证规律具有一致性。

title: New Evidence on the Health-Status Gradient from Imperial China
title_zh: 来自中华帝国的健康状况梯度新证据
title_primary: 来自中华帝国的健康状况梯度新证据
title_secondary: New Evidence on the Health-Status Gradient from Imperial China
authors: Wolfgang Keller, Carol H. Shiue, Karen Eggleston
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the relationship between health and social status in China using genealogical data from the 14th to 19th centuries. The data covers broad segments of the population linking husbands, wives, and sons, allowing us to examine whether status was associated with survival not only for adult men but also across households and generations. In a sample centered on the early 1700s, the typical lifespan of married men is 52, but varies widely. High-status men have a 22 percent higher probability of living past 50 than low-status men, resulting in a lifespan advantage of seven years. High status is also associated with significant survival advantages for wives and children. The lifespan premium of the wife of a high-status man over the wife of a commoner exceeds 10 years, and the chance that the son of a high-status man dies before reaching 10 years is less than half that of a low-status man’s son. Up to the 17th century the lifespan advantage is largely confined to those with top status, while the health-status gradient across all status levels emerges during the 18th century. The findings provide new evidence on health-status inequality in a less-studied setting, and suggest that health-status inequality is usefully analyzed from a family and intergenerational perspective.
abstract_zh: 本文利用14至19世纪中国的家谱数据，研究健康与社会地位之间的关系。数据覆盖了广泛的社会阶层，将丈夫、妻子和儿子联系起来，使我们能够考察地位是否不仅与成年男性的生存相关，还涉及家庭内部及代际之间的影响。在以18世纪初为中心的样本中，已婚男性的典型寿命为52岁，但个体差异显著。高地位男性活过50岁的概率比低地位男性高出22%，寿命优势达七年。高地位还与妻子和子女的显著生存优势相关：高地位男性妻子的寿命比平民妻子高出十年以上，而高地位男性之子在10岁前死亡的概率不到低地位男性之子的一半。直至17世纪，寿命优势主要局限于最高地位群体，而18世纪期间，所有地位层级均出现了健康-地位梯度。这些发现为较少被研究的背景下的健康-地位不平等提供了新证据，并表明从家庭和代际视角分析健康-地位不平等具有重要价值。

title: Assessing the Benefits of Optimized Agentic AI Systems for Asset Pricing
title_zh: 评估优化代理型人工智能系统对资产定价的益处
title_primary: 评估优化代理型人工智能系统对资产定价的益处
title_secondary: Assessing the Benefits of Optimized Agentic AI Systems for Asset Pricing
authors: Ralph Koijen, Bradford Levy
official: 官方在线 2026-06-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Evaluating optimized AI systems for asset pricing is fundamentally difficult for two reasons. First, models are trained on all data, implying that any backtest or analysis using historical data suffers from look-ahead bias. In addition, markets are reflexive — as investors adopt AI, prices adjust — which may erode the very patterns the AI system was trained to exploit. We introduce a real-time, out-of-sample benchmark designed to sidestep both problems. The benchmark measures how well AI systems can explain contemporaneous stock returns around earnings announcements using only information available at announcement time, including the text of the announcement itself. Applying this benchmark to a range of agentic AI systems — which extract structured signals from earnings call transcripts and optimize over those signals — we find that the best-optimized systems more than double the explained variation in returns relative to standard benchmarks (R2 increasing from 8% to close to 20%). We show that AI-based optimization can deliver efficiency gains relative to traditional machine learning methods while also improving interpretability as our approach produces human-readable economic mechanisms that explain price movements. These learned rules can be compared to the drivers of realized returns in existing asset pricing models to identify missing sources of variation in a data-driven, self-evolving way that integrates empirical learning with economic structure. We release an SDK for researchers to improve on our results. Saturating this benchmark would represent fundamental progress in understanding how capital markets process firm-level information.
abstract_zh: 评估针对资产定价优化的AI系统存在两个根本性困难。首先，模型基于全部数据训练，这意味着任何使用历史数据的回测或分析都存在前瞻性偏差。其次，市场具有反身性——随着投资者采用AI技术，价格会相应调整——这可能导致AI系统原本训练利用的模式逐渐消失。我们引入了一个实时、样本外的基准测试，旨在规避这两个问题。该基准衡量AI系统仅利用公告发布时可获取的信息（包括公告文本本身）来解释盈余公告期间同期股票收益的能力。将该基准应用于一系列智能体AI系统（这些系统从财报电话会议记录中提取结构化信号并对其进行优化），我们发现最优化的系统相较于标准基准，其解释的收益变异幅度提升了一倍以上（R²从8%提升至接近20%）。研究表明，基于AI的优化相较于传统机器学习方法能实现效率提升，同时增强可解释性——我们的方法可生成解释价格变动的人类可读经济机制。这些学习规则可与现有资产定价模型中已实现收益的驱动因素进行对比，以数据驱动、自我演进的方式识别缺失的变异来源，实现经验学习与经济结构的融合。我们发布了SDK供研究者改进现有成果。若该基准达到饱和，将标志着理解资本市场如何处理企业层面信息的根本性突破。

title: Market Effects of Brand Search Advertising
title_zh: 品牌搜索广告的市场效应
title_primary: 品牌搜索广告的市场效应
title_secondary: Market Effects of Brand Search Advertising
authors: Massimo Motta, Antonio Penta
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the market effects of sponsored search auctions for advertising space on searches for brands. In our model, firms simultaneously choose the price of their product and the bids for the advertising auctions triggered by their own and rivals' brand keywords search. In any symmetric equilibrium, each firm wins its own keyword auction, and relative to a no‐ads benchmark, online advertising raises the winning brand's marginal cost and ultimately market prices. Only in an environment with strong initial asymmetries do we find that brand advertising might be beneficial.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了品牌搜索中赞助搜索广告拍卖的市场效应。在模型中，企业同时选择产品价格以及针对自身和竞争对手品牌关键词搜索触发的广告拍卖出价。在任何对称均衡中，每家企业都能赢得自身关键词拍卖；与无广告基准相比，在线广告提高了获胜品牌的边际成本，并最终推高了市场价格。仅在初始不对称性较强的环境中，我们才发现品牌广告可能是有益的。

title: Integrated territorial development in action
title_zh: 行动中的区域一体化发展
title_primary: 行动中的区域一体化发展
title_secondary: Integrated territorial development in action
authors: Saraceno Pier, Fioretti Carlotta, Landucci Simone, Stavropoulos Eleftherios, Spalazzi Annalisa
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This report presents an EU-wide stocktake of Integrated Territorial Development Strategies (ITDSs) implemented under Cohesion Policy 2021–2027, drawing on data from STRAT-Board, the JRC–DG REGIO platform monitoring integrated territorial approaches. The dataset covers 87 Managing Authorities, 110 programmes and 1, 426 strategies - around 70% of all ITDSs - representing the most comprehensive evidence available for this programming period. Integrated Territorial Development (ITD) accounts for EUR 41.3 billion (~11% of total EU Cohesion Policy contributions), with uptake varying considerably across Member States due to differences in governance systems, administrative capacity and strategic interpretation. Integrated Territorial Investment (ITI) is the most widely used delivery mechanism, followed by Other Territorial Tools (OTTs) and Community-led Local Development (CLLD). While Sustainable Urban Development (SUD) remains central, most strategies target small and medium-sized territories: 85% cover areas below 250, 000 inhabitants and nearly half focus on territories under 50, 000. Over half span mixed urban–rural geographies, reflecting the importance of functional territorial linkages. Financially, SUD strategies mobilise substantially higher per-capita investments than non-SUD strategies, which tend to support smaller-scale, community-oriented interventions. Thematic priorities concentrate on integrated territorial development, biodiversity, energy efficiency and sustainable mobility. Governance arrangements are generally formalised, though practices vary in strategy selection, project identification and monitoring. Overall, the findings highlight the growing importance and heterogeneous implementation of ITD, underscoring the need to strengthen local capacity and enhance place-based impact.
abstract_zh: 本报告基于STRAT-Board（欧盟委员会联合研究中心与区域政策总司监测综合区域方法的平台）数据，对2021-2027年凝聚政策框架下实施的欧盟范围内综合区域发展战略（ITDSs）进行了全面评估。数据集涵盖87个管理机构、110个项目和1426项战略（约占全部ITDSs的70%），是本规划周期内可获得的最全面证据。综合区域发展（ITD）涉及413亿欧元资金（约占欧盟凝聚政策总投入的11%），各成员国因治理体系、行政能力和战略解读差异导致实施程度显著不同。综合区域投资（ITI）是最广泛采用的实施机制，其次为其他区域工具（OTTs）和社区主导地方发展（CLLD）。尽管可持续城市发展（SUD）仍居核心地位，但多数战略聚焦中小型区域：85%覆盖人口低于25万的区域，近半数关注人口不足5万的区域。超过半数战略涵盖城乡混合地理空间，反映出功能性区域关联的重要性。在资金配置方面，SUD战略的人均投资额显著高于非SUD战略，后者更倾向于支持小规模、社区导向的干预措施。主题优先领域集中于综合区域发展、生物多样性、能源效率和可持续交通。治理安排普遍实现规范化，但在战略选择、项目识别和监测环节存在实践差异。总体而言，研究结果凸显了ITD日益增长的重要性与实施异质性，强调需加强地方能力建设并提升基于地域的影响力。

title: Adding race and ethnicity to microeconomic databases: An assessment of alternative options
title_zh: 将种族和族裔纳入微观经济数据库：替代方案的评估
title_primary: 将种族和族裔纳入微观经济数据库：替代方案的评估
title_secondary: Adding race and ethnicity to microeconomic databases: An assessment of alternative options
authors: Keith Ihlanfeldt, Luke P. Rodgers, Cynthia Fan Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-02-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Estimating differences between racial/ethnic groups often requires merging demographic variables from one dataset to variables of interest in another. A common method merges Home Mortgage Disclosure Act data to property databases. One alternative is to acquire this information from voter registration files; another is to predict race with a name-based algorithm. Compared to Census data, which method is more representative varies by location and group. We explore the practical implications of each method by using the matched samples in two empirical applications. Researchers can arrive at different conclusions about racial/ethnic disparities depending on the method selected.
abstract_zh: 估算种族/族裔群体间的差异，通常需要将某一数据集的人口统计变量与另一数据集中的兴趣变量进行合并。一种常见方法是将《住房抵押贷款披露法》数据与房产数据库合并。另一种替代方案是从选民登记文件中获取此类信息；还有一种方法则是利用基于姓名的算法来预测种族。与人口普查数据相比，哪种方法更具代表性，因地点和群体而异。我们通过两个实证应用中的匹配样本，探讨了每种方法的实际影响。研究人员根据所选方法的不同，可能会对种族/族裔差异得出不同的结论。

title: Pricing in Crisis
title_zh: 危机中的定价
title_primary: 危机中的定价
title_secondary: Pricing in Crisis
authors: Reyer Gerlagh, Matti Liski, Iivo Vehviläinen
official: 官方在线 2025-12-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: When demand aggregates both price-sensitive and price-insensitive behaviors, uniform pricing becomes a deficient market design that generates negative surplus during extreme-price events. We develop a price-control mechanism that efficiently resolves the tradeoff between protecting consumers and limiting rents. The mechanism implements a dynamic price cap that responds to demand adjustments and induces truthful supply through incentive payments. In a quantitative application to the French wholesale electricity market during the 2022–2023 energy crisis, the mechanism would have lowered expected procurement costs by roughly €200 billion, about two-thirds of total projected costs in this central scenario.
abstract_zh: 当需求同时包含价格敏感与价格不敏感行为时，统一定价成为有缺陷的市场设计，会在极端价格事件中产生负剩余。我们提出一种价格控制机制，能够有效解决消费者保护与租金限制之间的权衡。该机制实施动态价格上限，根据需求调整作出响应，并通过激励支付诱导真实供给。在2022-2023年能源危机期间法国电力批发市场的量化应用中，该机制将使预期采购成本降低约2000亿欧元，约占该基准情景下总预期成本的三分之二。

title: Taylor Rule Deviations Across Horizons: A Practical Tool for Monetary Policy
title_zh: 跨期限泰勒规则偏离：货币政策实用工具
title_primary: 跨期限泰勒规则偏离：货币政策实用工具
title_secondary: Taylor Rule Deviations Across Horizons: A Practical Tool for Monetary Policy
authors: MASAZUMI HATTORI, TOMOHIDE MINEYAMA, JOUCHI NAKAJIMA
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-11-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose “Taylor rule yields” across horizons for the United States. Applying the standard Taylor rule to expected paths of inflation and the output gap, we construct a sequence of short‐term rates under neutral monetary policy stances, whose average defines the Taylor rule yield at each horizon. Taylor rule deviations (TRDs), the gaps between market‐expected rates and these yields, excluding risk premia, capture the effective stance of monetary policy even under the effective lower bound (ELB). TRDs also help disentangle the role of the ELB from other factors, offering insight into the severity and nature of the policy constraint.
abstract_zh: 我们针对美国提出了跨期限的“泰勒规则收益率”。将标准泰勒规则应用于预期通胀路径和产出缺口，我们构建了在中性货币政策立场下的一系列短期利率序列，其平均值定义了各期限的泰勒规则收益率。泰勒规则偏差（TRDs），即市场预期利率与这些收益率之间的差额（剔除风险溢价），即使在有效下限（ELB）条件下也能捕捉货币政策的实际立场。TRDs还有助于将ELB的作用与其他因素区分开来，为政策约束的严重性和性质提供洞见。

title: Seat allocation problem in public transportation
title_zh: 公共交通中的座位分配问题
title_primary: 公共交通中的座位分配问题
title_secondary: Seat allocation problem in public transportation
authors: Mustafa Oğuz Afacan, Ayşe Dur, Umut Dur
official: 官方在线 2025-10-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study a seat allocation problem in public transportation with potential seating restrictions. We first demonstrate that the commonly used procedure suffers from significant drawbacks, including welfare losses due to unfilled seats. We then introduce a new mechanism that addresses these deficiencies while also satisfying several other desirable properties under various seating restrictions. We also show that our proposed mechanism ensures that the maximum number of agents are seated while respecting agents' preferences and priority rankings.
abstract_zh: 我们研究公共交通中可能存在的座位限制下的座位分配问题。首先，我们证明常用程序存在显著缺陷，包括因空座导致的福利损失。随后，我们引入一种新机制，该机制在解决这些缺陷的同时，还满足多种座位限制下的其他理想性质。我们还表明，我们提出的机制确保在尊重乘客偏好和优先级排序的前提下，尽可能多的乘客能够就座。

title: Carbon VIX: Carbon price uncertainty and decarbonization investments
title_zh: 碳VIX：碳价格不确定性与脱碳投资
title_primary: 碳VIX：碳价格不确定性与脱碳投资
title_secondary: Carbon VIX: Carbon price uncertainty and decarbonization investments
authors: Maximilian Fuchs, Johannes Stroebel, Julian Terstegge
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2024-09-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the effects of carbon price uncertainty on firms’ decisions to decarbonize their operations. We first use information on the pricing of options on emission allowances in the European Emissions Trading System to create the Carbon VIX, a market-based high-frequency measure of carbon price uncertainty. Carbon price uncertainty is high, varies substantially over time, and experiences persistent shocks around major climate policy events. To explore the effects of carbon price uncertainty on expected aggregate decarbonization investments, we analyze its effect on the stock returns of firms that help other businesses decarbonize. To identify these “carbon solution providers”, we extract common types of decarbonization investments from a large survey of firms, and then identify companies that offer the associated goods and services. We find that the stock returns of these carbon solution providers vary positively with carbon prices, but negatively with carbon price uncertainty. The effect of increases in carbon price uncertainty on our proxy for expected decarbonization investments is economically large and of similar magnitude as the effect of declines in carbon prices. These findings support predictions from real options theory that firms may delay investments in decarbonization when faced with uncertainty about the future costs of emissions.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了碳价不确定性对企业脱碳运营决策的影响。首先，利用欧洲排放交易体系中排放配额期权定价的信息，构建了碳VIX指数，这是一种基于市场的高频碳价不确定性度量指标。碳价不确定性水平较高，随时间显著波动，并在重大气候政策事件期间经历持续性冲击。为探究碳价不确定性对预期总体脱碳投资的影响，我们分析了其对帮助其他企业实现脱碳的公司股票回报的影响。为识别这些“碳解决方案提供商”，我们从一项大规模企业调查中提取常见的脱碳投资类型，进而确定提供相关商品和服务的公司。研究发现，这些碳解决方案提供商的股票回报与碳价正相关，但与碳价不确定性负相关。碳价不确定性上升对我们预期脱碳投资代理指标的影响在经济规模上显著，且与碳价下降的影响程度相当。这些发现支持实物期权理论的预测，即当面临未来排放成本的不确定性时，企业可能会推迟脱碳投资。
